intervention: FlashBench v6 screening probes v3 isolate detector families and add a self-validating contract that excludes probe measurements from ranking unless axis invariance and expected threshold ordering are demonstrated.
qualitative_observation: The self-validation behaved correctly: the v3 probe contract failed because the full-screen and small-source residual ratios remained essentially invariant across the intended sensitivity axes, with one remaining profile-1 cross-axis anomaly. Probe data was automatically marked non-rankable, so candidate selection fell back to the established replay/trail/perceptual metrics and selected the production-default profile_1_full_1_small_1. The fast screen remains useful, but the profile/full/small settings are not a meaningful optimization space for the Instant GPU path; future search should expose direct benchmark-only detector/temporal thresholds instead of trying to infer them through UI sensitivity presets.
